generatedFor: What We Do in the Shadows

beats.label: S1 · The Baron's mission
beats.text: Ancient vampire Baron Afanas arrives from the Old Country and orders the Staten Island vampires to conquer the Western Hemisphere in the old masters' name.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the entire premise and the pressure the household is failing to meet.

beats.label: S1 · Every conquest fails
beats.text: Every attempt collapses: they can't sway the city council, and Manhattan's Simon steals Laszlo's cursed hat before his own nightclub explodes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Simon as a recurring rival and shows the four cannot actually execute the Baron's plan.

beats.label: S1 · Nandor won't turn Guillermo
beats.text: Guillermo has served Nandor for ten years hoping to be turned. When Nadja casually vamps a stranger named Jenna, it's clear Nandor's refusal is a choice.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The central relationship of the series: Guillermo's unrewarded loyalty and Nandor's evasion.

beats.label: S1 · The Baron dies
beats.text: A drug-laced night out ends with the Baron killed by sunlight the next morning; the Vampiric Council sentences the three vampires to death for his murder.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Council as executioners and plants the crime that fuels next season's assassin attacks.

beats.label: S1 · Guillermo saves them
beats.text: Guillermo shields the execution well with an umbrella and rescues the three from death. His loyalty is total, and his master still refuses to turn him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cements the pattern: Guillermo saves the vampires and Nandor still won't reciprocate.

beats.label: S1 · Van Helsing blood
beats.text: A DNA test reveals Guillermo descends from Van Helsing, the vampires' historic mortal enemies. He wonders if he's destined to kill the family he serves.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The secret that drives Guillermo's entire arc — kept from the vampires and unresolved.

cliffhanger.text: Guillermo has just discovered he descends from the vampire hunter Van Helsing — the exact lineage bred to kill the four creatures he has loyally served for ten years. He tells no one.
questions: Will Guillermo act on his bloodline or bury it?
Will Nandor ever actually turn him?
Will the Vampiric Council retaliate for the Baron's death?

characters.name: Nandor the Relentless
characters.line: Self-appointed leader of the house, an ancient warlord from a country that no longer exists; keeps Guillermo waiting to be turned.

characters.name: Guillermo de la Cruz
characters.line: Nandor's devoted familiar of ten years, still waiting to be turned; just discovered his Van Helsing lineage and told no one.

characters.name: Nadja
characters.line: Nandor's centuries-old housemate, married to Laszlo; casually turns humans herself, proving Nandor's refusal is a choice.

characters.name: Laszlo Cravensworth
characters.line: Nadja's English aristocrat husband; has quietly decapitated her past-life lover Gregor across every incarnation, including this one.

characters.name: Colin Robinson
characters.line: Their energy-vampire roommate who feeds by boring humans at an office job; barely tolerated by the others.

characters.name: Baron Afanas
characters.line: The ancient master from the Old Country who ordered the conquest of the Western Hemisphere; killed by sunlight after a drugged night out.

characters.name: The Vampiric Council
characters.line: Off-screen tribunal of vampire elders who judged the three for the Baron's death and still watch the household.

beats.label: S2 · Silent assassin
beats.text: The Vampiric Council sends assassins into the house. Guillermo silently kills each one and hides the bodies while the vampires notice nothing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Starts Guillermo's kill count and the running joke that the vampires are oblivious to what he's actually capable of.

beats.label: S2 · The Mosquito Club
beats.text: Guillermo joins what he thinks is a mosquito-hunting club, discovers it's a real vampire-hunter cell, and on his first raid slaughters an entire nest.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Confirms Guillermo isn't just lucky — he's skilled — and gives him a community that knows what he is.

beats.label: S2 · Nadja in the doll
beats.text: A séance brings Nadja's own ghost back; she takes up residence in a porcelain doll and becomes a permanent, chatty member of the household.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Adds a new recurring character who persists across every following season.

beats.label: S2 · Nandor grows suspicious
beats.text: Simon the Devious returns humbled. When his crewmate Carol accuses Guillermo of being a slayer, Guillermo kills her in self-defense — and Nandor takes note.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First time Nandor witnesses Guillermo dispatch a vampire; the secret starts leaking.

beats.label: S2 · Guillermo almost quits
beats.text: Nandor keeps promising to turn Guillermo and never does. Guillermo briefly leaves to serve a household that actually welcomes him, before returning.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows Guillermo's patience is finite; a rehearsal for the bigger break coming later.

beats.label: S2 · The theatre massacre
beats.text: The Council lures the four to a theatre trap and sentences them to death for Guillermo's kills. He slaughters the room to save them, exposing himself as a vampire hunter.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The reveal that reshapes every relationship going forward and directly triggers next season's power shift.

cliffhanger.text: Guillermo has just butchered a theatre full of vampires — including most of the East Coast Council — to save his masters. He stands over the bodies as the four finally realise what he actually is.
questions: Will the vampires kill Guillermo or thank him?
Who's left of the Vampiric Council after this?
Where does the household go now that his secret is out?

characters.name: Guillermo de la Cruz
characters.line: Nandor's familiar and secret vampire killer; just outed after slaughtering a theatre full of vampires to save the household.

characters.name: Nandor the Relentless
characters.line: Still Guillermo's master and still refuses to turn him; has begun noticing his familiar's unusual skill with a stake.

characters.name: Nadja
characters.line: Now shares the house with her own ghost, embedded in a porcelain doll she talks to as a separate person.

characters.name: Laszlo Cravensworth
characters.line: Nadja's husband; briefly ran off as a Pennsylvania bartender named Jackie Daytona to escape a vampire debt collector before coming back.

characters.name: Colin Robinson
characters.line: Energy-vampire roommate, unchanged; his brief godlike promotion at work self-destructed and left him back where he started.

characters.name: Nadja Doll
characters.line: Nadja's own ghost, permanently living in a porcelain doll and speaking as a separate housemate.

characters.name: The Vampiric Council
characters.line: Set the theatre trap and lost catastrophically; most of the East Coast leadership is dead by Guillermo's hand.

beats.label: S3 · Reluctant new Council
beats.text: After the theatre massacre, the Supreme Council appoints the four vampires as the new Eastern Seaboard Council and forces Guillermo into service as their bodyguard.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Guillermo's slaughter created the power vacuum; the four now run the region, however incompetently.

beats.label: S3 · The Guide, Sire, and Baron
beats.text: Their new Council liaison, the Guide, arrives and stays. The world's first vampire, the Sire, escapes its cell, and the Baron is dug up alive from the yard to help catch it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Adds three permanent supernatural fixtures — the Guide, the Sire, and the resurrected Baron — that the following seasons rely on.

beats.label: S3 · Nandor's depression
beats.text: Nandor spirals into depression and joins Jan's Wellness Center cult; Guillermo rescues and deprograms him, but the underlying misery doesn't heal.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Nandor's decision to abandon the house and travel; without this, his exit at season's end has no motive.

beats.label: S3 · Colin dies, a baby appears
beats.text: Colin Robinson reaches his hundredth year — an energy vampire's full lifespan — and dies. Days later, a baby version of him bursts from his corpse.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the adult Colin and introduces the Baby Colin arc that anchors the next season.

beats.label: S3 · The household splits
beats.text: Nandor decides to travel the world and promises to finally turn Guillermo in his ancestral homeland; Nadja is invited to join the Supreme Council in London with Laszlo.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Every character's next destination is set here — this is the pivot point of the season.

beats.label: S3 · Laszlo's betrayal
beats.text: At the last moment Laszlo locks Guillermo in his coffin so he can secretly stay behind with Baby Colin. Nandor leaves alone, and Guillermo is shipped to London with Nadja.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The exact configuration everyone wakes up in next season depends on this switch.

cliffhanger.text: The household has fractured. Nandor waits alone at a train station believing Guillermo stood him up, Guillermo is trapped in Laszlo's coffin bound for London, and Laszlo is hiding on Staten Island with a baby that just burst from Colin Robinson's corpse.
questions: How will each of them react when they realise where they've ended up?
What exactly is Baby Colin, and is he Colin Robinson?
Will Nandor ever keep his promise to turn Guillermo?

characters.name: Guillermo de la Cruz
characters.line: Just betrayed by Laszlo and locked in a coffin bound for London with Nadja, having lost his chance to finally be turned by Nandor.

characters.name: Nandor the Relentless
characters.line: Left New York alone by train to travel the world, believing Guillermo abandoned him after promising to be at the station.

characters.name: Nadja
characters.line: On a ship to London to take up a seat on the Supreme Vampiric Council, unaware Guillermo is trapped in Laszlo's coffin beside her.

characters.name: Laszlo Cravensworth
characters.line: Secretly stayed behind on Staten Island to raise the baby that emerged from Colin Robinson's corpse; sent his wife off without him.

characters.name: Colin Robinson
characters.line: Died on his hundredth birthday as all energy vampires do; a baby version of him has just burst from his dead body.

characters.name: The Guide
characters.line: The Council's liaison to the household; became a permanent housemate over the course of the season.

characters.name: The Baron
characters.line: Turned out to be alive after all — dug up armless and legless, capable of speaking the Sire's ancient language, now rehoused in New Jersey.

characters.name: The Sire
characters.line: The world's first and most ancient vampire; freed briefly, now pacified and rehoused in Nutley with the Baron.

characters.name: Nadja Doll
characters.line: Nadja's ghost in a porcelain doll; briefly ran off during the Council chaos, now back in the household.

beats.label: S4 · The house reunites
beats.text: A year later the household reunites in a wrecked house — Nandor single, Nadja back from London, Laszlo secretly raising the toddler-sized Baby Colin the whole time.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the board after the split and establishes the year Laszlo has spent alone parenting.

beats.label: S4 · The vampire nightclub
beats.text: To pay for repairs, Nadja and the Guide open a vampire nightclub in the old Council building; Baby Colin becomes its star attraction.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The club is the season's central location and Nadja and the Guide's shared enterprise.

beats.label: S4 · The Djinn and Marwa
beats.text: Nandor finds a Djinn in the basement with 52 wishes. He resurrects his 37 dead wives, picks Marwa, and marries her — after wishing that she likes what he likes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Nandor's compromised marriage and the wish mechanic that lets him tamper with Guillermo's love life next.

beats.label: S4 · Nandor betrays Guillermo
beats.text: When Guillermo brings his boyfriend Freddie home, Nandor jealously wishes Marwa into a Freddie double; the two Freddies end up together, leaving Guillermo alone.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The concrete injury that convinces Guillermo his master will never treat him as an equal.

beats.label: S4 · Colin restored
beats.text: Baby Colin grows to adulthood, finds a hidden room of diaries, and transforms back into the original Colin Robinson — with no memory of his baby year.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Restores the adult Colin Robinson and closes out the Baby Colin storyline for good.

beats.label: S4 · Guillermo walks out
beats.text: Disillusioned that nothing in the house will ever change, Guillermo takes the money he embezzled from the club, goes to Derek, and asks to be turned into a vampire.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The final cliffhanger: after ten-plus years of waiting for Nandor, Guillermo has stopped asking.

cliffhanger.text: Guillermo has finally given up on Nandor. He has walked out of the household with a suitcase of embezzled club money and asked a low-level vampire he barely knows to give him what his master never would.
questions: How will Nandor react when he realises Guillermo has left?
What happens when a Van Helsing descendant becomes a vampire?

characters.name: Guillermo de la Cruz
characters.line: Just walked out on Nandor with a suitcase of embezzled nightclub money and asked Derek to turn him into a vampire himself.

characters.name: Derek
characters.line: A low-level vampire Guillermo befriended; the one Guillermo has just asked to give him what Nandor never would.

characters.name: Nandor the Relentless
characters.line: Married Marwa via a wish, then transformed her into a Freddie clone out of jealousy over Guillermo; now essentially alone, with three wishes left.

characters.name: Colin Robinson
characters.line: Fully restored from Baby Colin's body; runs the household finances again but remembers nothing of his year lived as a child.

characters.name: Laszlo Cravensworth
characters.line: Raised Baby Colin for a year as "Boy"; now quietly grieving the child he lost when the original Colin returned.

characters.name: Nadja
characters.line: Back from London for good, running the vampire nightclub in the former Council building alongside the Guide.

characters.name: The Guide
characters.line: Nadja's partner in the nightclub and her closest confidante; friend rather than crush to Guillermo.

characters.name: The Djinn
characters.line: Granted most of Nandor's 52 wishes; a smaller lamp with three more sits on Nandor's shelf.

characters.name: Nadja Doll
characters.line: Still around, still voicing her opinions from her porcelain body.
